utility_weight_policy.fallback: if all-zero or non-finite, replace with zeros

risk_policy.formula: final_risk = clamp(0, 1, base_risk + risk_bias + sum(risk_trait_weights_i * trait_i))

templates.description: A shadow stalker is circling at the edge of torchlight.
templates.description_zh: 一隻暗影潛獵者在火光邊緣徘徊。

templates.description: A rune-bound chest sits alone in a damp chamber.
templates.description_zh: 一只符文封印的寶箱獨自佇立在潮濕的密室裡。

templates.description: A dormant altar hums with unreadable intent.
templates.description_zh: 一座沉睡的祭壇低鳴著，意圖難以揣測。

templates.description: The corridor splits into a narrow safe path and a deep echoing descent.
templates.description_zh: 走廊分岔成一條狹窄的安全小徑，與一道回音深沉的下行通道。

templates.description: A wave of panic rises with no visible source.
templates.description_zh: 一陣莫名的恐慌毫無來由地湧上心頭。

templates.description: Multiple figures burst from concealed alcoves — no time to plan.
templates.description_zh: 數道身影自暗處猛然撲出——沒有時間思考。

templates.description: A gleaming cache of valuables lies barely visible under rubble.
templates.description_zh: 一批閃爍的財寶半埋在碎石堆下，若隱若現。

templates.description: An ancient shrine pulses with an energy that defies interpretation.
templates.description_zh: 一座古老神龕脈動著難以解讀的能量。

templates.description: A stone bridge over a chasm is cracking underfoot with each step.
templates.description_zh: 橫跨深淵的石橋，每踏一步都在腳下龜裂。

templates.description: A sudden surge of clarity and determination rises from within.
templates.description_zh: 一股清明與決心驟然自內心升起。
